events.text: Root cause: storage/localstore.zig MAX_VALUE=8192 — the custom-textures value with inline pixel payloads (~125KB) silently failed every write (hostLocalstoreSet catch {}), so pixels never persisted: the baker re-baked forever (the alternating spam) and the compile correctly found none. Fix: pixels move OUT of the store value into files (user-directed format: the cart/pixel_icons rows-of-runs JSON), record carries {w,h,docHash,file}; baker gains a persist-verification park guard.

resolution: Fixed the re-bake spam and the 'no baked pixels' compile in one root cause (commit 412506717): the first cut stored the pixel RLE inline on the custom-textures record, but storage/localstore.zig caps values at 8KB (MAX_VALUE, fixed-width records) and hostLocalstoreSet swallows the failure silently — so ~50KB captures never persisted; the baker reloaded the store, saw the other decal still pixel-less, and re-baked in an endless alternating loop while the compile correctly found nothing. Pixels now live as files under cart/hmsc-int/data/decal-pixels/<id>.json in the repo's rows-of-runs pixel JSON format (per your pointer at cart/pixel_icons/), the record carries only {w,h,docHash,file}, and the baker verifies the store round-trip after every save — a failed persist parks the record with ONE console.error instead of spinning. Tests 13/13 green; cart + bake bundles clean. Verify: editor terminal should show each decal baked ONCE ([decal-bake] ... → file), then Compile should report 'N decal-pixel' in the [materials] line with no flat-color warning, then rjit game play shows the signs.
